# Pinterest Australia

> Pinterest Australia is a visual discovery platform featuring curated boards from fashion retailers, educational institutions, lifestyle brands, and creative communities.

The platform hosts official Pinterest profiles from major retailers like CETTIRE and Cool Shirtz, educational resources from Radiopaedia, interior design inspiration through Style Sourcebook, and creative building communities like Rebrickable. These accounts leverage Pinterest's collaborative board features to share style inspiration, educational content, and creative projects with Australian audiences.

## Key Topics

- Pinterest profiles
- luxury fashion
- fashion retailers
- style boards
- home decor inspiration
- radiology education
- medical reference
- LEGO creations
- collaborative learning
- social media curation
- fashion inspiration
- interior design
- diagnostic imaging
- merchandise collections
- custom builds

## Fashion & Retail Brands

- [CETTIRE](https://au.pinterest.com/cettire/): Luxury fashion retailer with curated style boards showcasing high-end bags, accessories, and designer collections
- [Cool Shirtz](https://au.pinterest.com/coolshirtz/): Clothing brand official Pinterest account featuring merchandise collections and apparel inspiration

## Lifestyle & Home Design

- [Style Sourcebook](https://au.pinterest.com/stylesourcebook/): Interior design mood board tool providing home decor inspiration and style guidance for residential spaces

## Educational & Reference Resources

- [Radiopaedia](https://au.pinterest.com/radiopaedia/): Official medical education boards featuring radiology content, diagnostic imaging, and clinical reference materials for healthcare professionals

## Creative Communities & Hobbies

- [Rebrickable](https://au.pinterest.com/rebrickable/): LEGO community platform sharing custom build instructions and creative construction projects using existing brick collections
